t:
Hey, buddy! Listen, I've got something to say. Did you ever happen to visit June Catacombs? If the answer's yes, then I have a job for you! That terrestrial cuttlefish Mohr is looking for sun minerals and offers lots of interesting stuff in exchange for them. I got an idea... I know how we both can benefit from it.
In short, bring me twenty minerals of that sort, and I'll give you a pirate costume in exchange! You won't find that costume anywhere else, I swear!

Yo, buddy! Listen up! You've ever been to the June catacombs? I've got work for you. This Mohr scumbag trades all kinds of curious stuff for ruby minerals.
So, I've got this idea how both of us can get profit... Bring me 20 Ruby minerals, and I'll swap them for a pirate costume! A rare one!
Well, how's it going? Found any minerals?
I'll be damned, you've made it! Well then, you take the suit, I take the minerals, as agreed. Now you look almost like a real astral pirate, haha!
Activate the June portal with your Adventurer's Stone, clear any demons guarding the portal, and return to Lord Zullo.

All right, now the connection between our minds is strong. We can talk.
Those dragon spirits' fears came true. Demons have already swarmed the cave. What's worse, they attacked when many Chosen Ones are near the end of their Path.
This will just prove to be another hurdle that Chosen Ones must pass. Even you have come this far. You cannot give up now!
You need to reach the final ruin and meet up with its dragon guide . It will be no easy task. First, you will have to clear the far June portal of demons and focus your stone on it.
Did you manage to focus the stone on our portal? Are demons dead?

That's great. Now we move forward.
Hurry up, demons are coming in. Soon they may reach the Village and the Performance will be in jeopardy...

h: Obtain Quest Log pages for the group adventure in Oreshek Fortress

t: These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
Use the Heart of Succubus on 5 cultists to measure their vital force.

Where to find a suitable subject body...
We are lucky to have collected the demons' gel to continue with the ritual. We are even more lucky to have cultists roaming around the caverns. The cultists so kindhearted straddle around in their whole-bodied selves... Hehe, a sense of humor can save the presence of mind even in such desperate situations like ours.
Take this succubus heart. This is a unique but handy artifact!
Use it to measure the vital force of its target. If the heart starts pulsating frequently, it means that the object is "fit". Apply it to the cultists and check if their bodies suit our needs.
So, the device works? The cultists are suitable for Osip's request?

I thought as much. The device is silent. It means that their power is weak.
We should find another candidate...
Get 8 Scenario Pages fighting against demon cultists and bring them to Lord Zullo.

Now that you know more about caves of Gipat, I want to assign you another task.
Every performance has its foundation. Scenario. Few pages contain hidden power of future representation. Believe me, this is a very important document. After reading it, you can learn about the future.
It's unfortunate that our scenario was stolen during one of their assaults. Our common enemy wants to know our future plans to counter our course of action.
Loss of scenario is a hard blow to the Performance. This will make us revise our plans and we would have to rewrite it from scratch.
In the near future, the information contained in its pages will lose its value, but not immediately. That's why we want it returned as soon as possible.
It is known that demons' cultists posses them now. Enemy knows about our plans and is ready to prevent it, so be careful. We must have the Scenario back in our grasp.
Power of word may be more dangerous than power of sword.

Yes, these are the pages we need. Now we are back in control.
Thank you for your help.

I helped you deal with Osip's situation and in response, I hope you can return the favor.
We will have to cross paths with demons once more. They will prevent your kind from gaining Revelation again and again. So we must be prepared to battle with demons. Do you know a lot about them?
I know much more than you, but not everything. Will you help enhance my knowledge?
What's important to me is knowing if demons possess a spark. All living creatures living in Sarnaut posses it, and you already know that demons are not aliens from another world. This means that they should have a spark, right? We will find it out.
I'm sure it won't be easy. If a spark exists, it is hidden deep. Take this artifact. It should let you extract sparks from demons' ashes. I'm almost sure that it is there. If your attempts fail, do not despair. You should find their remains eventually.
I strongly recommend that you use my artifact only on the strongest and most dangerous demons. I'm talking about blazing and fierce demons. Mizra the Wicked will be ok too. Using the artifact against other breeds will only reward you with dust.
The more information you have about your enemy, the easier it is to defeat them.

I'm glad that your perseverance has given results. Just as I requested.
Thank you.
Now I need only to compare these sparks with those of other citizens of Sarnaut. But that's another story...

h: I've lost the jar with Osip's spark.

t: Find the bodies of the fallen leaders and bring their Journals to Lord Zullo.

You want to know who we are... I would like to know the answer to this question. The real answer...
Do you remember the words of ancient legends? "There is much great knowledge if it is obtained without a fight. It is gained by someone else through suffering and given to you as a loan. If it is gained without diligence, you will never realize its value to find a use of it".
I will direct you and you will find the answers to your questions by yourself.
Many of us have fallen in battle with demons. We have experienced much hardship but acquired valuable knowledge over time. Find the bodies of the fallen and bring me their personal journal records. They will give you the first clue to discovering the answers.
Unfortunately, too many of us have fallen in battle. I am sure it won't take you long to find the bodies lying around...

So, the books are collected. I will read you a passage from "Domestication". It should hopefully give you the answer.
"When the hunting season is open, deer becomes lizard. When the boats ship out, fish become seashells. When glaciers approach, elephants become mammoths. Slay the part of yourself that is known to the enemy. Let them triumph. The rest of your remaining will create a new self not recognized by death".
Still confused? All right, I have one more hint for you.

Did you manage to gather measures of Astral power dioxide?
I mean, "Astral gel"...

Great... This gel is enough to resurrect Osip and we will have a bit left to fill a pipe if time allows it...
All we need now is to find a new body. As you understand, nobody will willingly give it up. That's why the body should be taken from someone to whom you do not feel sympathy to not burden your conscience.
Maybe you have some valid candidates? You continue to forget I can read your mind. The League and the Empire are allies now. Your current thoughts are not an option.
Create 3 Wormface Ammunition and deliver them to the three Wormface Mages.

I see you are interested in magical things that we sell, eh? First, you will have to prove that you can be trusted with such powerful artifacts. Earn our trust by your deeds and you can dress self in our armor and wield weapons of your choosing.
A few of our combat mages hold back the army of demons at the edge of the ravine. I need brave souls to deliver them more magical charges, so they can continue fighting the good fight. We create our magic from Astral materials, which can be extracted from demons. Force, of course.
As soon as collect some Astral samples, bring them back here and toss them into this Death Bowl. Eventually the magical charges will solidify for you to take to our mages on the field.
Have you renewed the Mages' power yet? Hurry up! If our mages energy runs dry, then we won't be able to stop the demon invasion!

Few more precious minutes redeemed from death...
Why are you still here? That task alone will not solely impress our Masters. You will have to try harder if you want to earn our trust.
Plant four magic bombs on the bridge across the ravine, and detonate the bombs from a safe distance. Report back to Lord Krosus when you have completed your mission.

The most fierce battles rage on to gain control of that damned bridge across the gorge. Every hour our forces exchange blows with demons back and forth.
 We need to achieve ownership of that passage way in order to gain advantage over the demons! I prepared some magic bombs. Sneak on to the bridge when the next wave of demons come our way and plant them in the perfect spot. The stone slabs at the edges of the bridge should fit nicely.
Be sure to move away to a safe distance, wait for the demons run across the bridge, and detonate away!
I've heard a loud crumbling - was that clamor from my mana bombs? Or was that just another collapse?

I probably went overboard with the power of the charges. At least the bridge is still intact for our usage. No worries, the bridge carries ancient history. It was enchanted by dragons, so it will endure the biggest explosions.
By the way, I managed to collect three more bombs. Would you like to see fireworks again?
Find the Astral portal in the caves behind the ravine and kill 10 Cruel Predators along with the Kixxar the Keeper.

We have found the portal that provides passage for the demons. It is further in the caves behind the ravine. We need to close this festering wound! Kill cruel predators, and most importantly, the portal guardian, Kixxar the Keeper . The fierce beast is what keeps the portal open although it drains some of its strength, but it is still a very lethal opponent.
Why do I send you? Well, all of our warriors are busy with fending on demons from entering this safe haven, and I am just an ordinary craftsman.
You, however, are the Chosen One who strives to earn our trust. Here is the chance to show the Lords who's boss!

Is the beast finally dead? Is the portal closed?
Hurry up if you don't want demons to flush us out!

They will need some time to open the portal again. This will give us a break.
As for your reproachful look... I heard one story. One famous troupe performed its play many times. With each performance, it proved to be difficult to maintain their reputation and consistency. One after another, exhausted actors started to leave until only a few remained. They performed their last performance with a full house, and went to another theater.
The way the story ends is that they worked as ordinary stage engineers to help young actors perform greatly, and they were able to keep putting on great shows while keeping their troupe together.
I hope you found that tale to be inspiring, Chosen One. They had their chance. Now the stage belongs to you.
After asking Lord Zullo to send you to the portal, kill 4 Vile Demon Mages guarding the final portal.

Your mind is torn from the questions that need answering. You will never hear my shouting even with all that clutter in your head. My voice is drowned among endless cries: your fears, dreams, guesses...
You must understand that it is not answers, but the questions themselves contain the real knowledge. There is one legend... Never mind. Now is not the time for tales.
You have to go to the ruins of the next portal and cleanse it of foulness. As soon as you get there, you will find yourself under extreme pressure. Unpleasant feeling, I should say. You'll find a wave of resistance guarding this next portal since it's the shortest way to the ancient June temple, the final destination where Revelation waits for you.
Activate the second portal and clear any demons preventing you from escaping. Inform me once you have succeeded, so I can prepare to send you to your final destination.
Is the portal cleared? We need to try to ease the way for other Chose Ones so that demons can't prevent them from playing their role in the Performance.

I am obliged to you for your help. Allow me to explain the essence of what's left of your Path.
I remember one legend... Once a wise man asked his friend to present him a treasure chest. After receiving the gift, he did not open it, saying: "I may have only one handful of gold, glittering stones, or ancient vase. But until I open the chest, the treasure is mine." When the sage died, his son, nevertheless, opened the chest. There lay only one note. "I knew that you would never open the chest. And if you do open it - it wouldn't belong to you any more."
That wise man knew the value of mystery, the question without the answer. You think that only the answers are valuable, and crave them.
Let your ignorance protect you until you obtain enough power to withstand the truth.
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...

h: Teleport to the first set of ruins

t:
I promised to give you one more hint of our secret identity. Take this rod and activate it with the help of ancient golem guards. Their ancient battle exhausted their forces. You need to recharge them.
Bringing the rusted back to life will help lead you the right way.

You have to activate enough golems to hold the remains of demons away from the central hills.
I am increasingly worried that many Chosen Ones will not have time to finish their Path.

Very efficient devices, aren't they? They're composed of an extremely sophisticated system and complex algorithm. That's why it is difficult for others except the creator to command the golems. Zem, despite his breakthrough in mechanics and prosthetics, failed to create anything like that.
I can already see a spark of understanding in your eyes. The answer has not yet surfaced from your subconscious, but it is already inside you. Give it time to settle.
With all eyes on you, march to the center of these Ruins, and smash the Weapon of War. Bring its remnants to the Spirit of Peace.

Gipat is a peaceful land.
Gaze at the lush terrain. When a hunter kills a wolf to feed himself, it is an act of enmity. Ath-Zak's Chosen Path was to cleanse Gipat of many dangers. Those who help finish what he has started will gain Revelation.
With all the bloodshed that exists in Sarnaut, we must leave those troubles behind. The past wars have established the races' pre-determined roles that blind them from Revelation. It doesn't benefit a man to kill another man, or for a mighty Orc to raise an axe on his Gibberling foes. Elves create magical wonders while Arisen carry messages about the meaning of the death to all beings. Nobody is created to kill just as no one is created to die before one's time.
Great truth is earned by putting down one's sword and lending one's free hand to yesterday's enemy. Prove that knowledge is power. Take this Weapon of War to the center of these Ruins, and shatter it within sight of all in sign of a Great Truce.
Only one who can put up with the enemy and look beyond one's differences for the sake of the eternal peace is heading to the Chosen Path of greatness!
I am proud of you and believe in your peaceful intentions. The Chosen Path is open to you!
Find the League Chosen and save him. Report to Lord Dray after.

Now you respect the League as a powerful ally, but you have take a step further and understand that they are the same beings like you. They also have their fears and hopes, talents and shortcomings. And perhaps, in time, you can accept and love them as if they were your allies.
I want compassion to help you make the first step towards love. Chosen of the League needs your help. Help him like you help your own kind.

Ah, the enemy...
Finish me off if you want.
Do the work of demons. I wouldn't expect less of any Imperial scum!

Demons... They wounded me... It hurts...
You're not going to finish me off? That's rather odd for a representative of the Empire.
Then listen! Once our ancestors fought together against these Astral incarnates! It's time for to join forces once again!
Avenge me, kill the slimy demons and their leader. It was they who...
One thing I ask you, Tensess... Don't let me die without being avenged!

What do you feel when you save your former enemy's life? It is not so much unnatural but a noble action of which you are really proud!

Have you ever had Kanian pancakes while washing them down with Gibberling malted beer? Have you ever had a chance to listen to a symphony written by an Elf and performed by a string quartet? It's all ahead of you, and it is going to take you to cloud number nine.

The Spark cannot resist beauty, whatever the source. Beauty is the sole uniting force!

My name is Lord Dray as I am responsible for ensuring the orchestra of Chosen Ones play consistently without a hitch. Otherwise, we all fail at the premiere. Prove that the Empire is ready to reject hatred and prejudices, and I will consider your alliance proposal.
This lamp has been hanging in front of the altar of Novograd church for years. It was fanned by the breath of Tensess listening to parishioners' prayers. It keeps their hopes high in hard times and it generates strong compassion for their families thanks to the merciful Tensess. Light it and present it to the Great Mage. Agree to become his punishing sword in struggle with astral spawn.
This artifact will help you to fight with demons, but more importantly, it will give you a chance for feel respect for your enemy.
Did the lamp help you to fight against demons? The power of light can blind, but don't let its power dope you.

So, the lamp was tested and I see you are reluctant to return it. This is good.
Unfortunately, demons of the new breed carry so much darkness inside that no lamp can dissipate it... They seem to shrug off Tensess' influence, and you feel his support no more. Despair may shake the faith of even the most genuine followers. I am sure the Church will find the way to deal with them.
Do you now understand why it is so important for the Empire to act in cooperation with the League? Combining the fruits of scientific thought from the ZIT and the achievements of the Church, you will become the strongest alliance in history. Think about it. Is it not tempting?
Find the Chosen One of the Empire that needs help and save him. The results must be informed to Lord Dray.

Now you respect the Empire as a powerful ally, but you have take a step further and understand that they are the same beings like you. They also have their fears and hopes, talents and shortcomings. And perhaps, in time, you can accept and love them as if they were your allies.
I want compassion to help you make the first step towards love. Chosen of the Empire needs your help. Help him like you help your own kind.

How do you feel saving your former enemy's life? Besides the unnatural feeling that you're proud of your nobility, huh?
Have you ever been to Nezebgrad? Have you ever admired the grand Xadaganian architecture and awesome monuments where one can see fresh flowers everyday? Have you been fortunate to see the elevation in the eyes of Orcs that have just scored a winning goal or studied philosophic works of Zem?
Admiration of Imperial citizens' devotion, bravery, and desire to learn will help you to step over the existing hostility. Shared values - that's what can unite our two factions.

Damn, how could I let this happen to me?
I was attacked by a horde of demons - trampled, slashed! Now I'll rise and kick all your asses!
...I can't!
The League is already here! You like to see me suffering, don't you? No help from you...
What? You're willing to take revenge for me?
Ha... then try. Demons that ruined me were Brutal Predators - and their leader, Ku'fan the Abyssal. Avenge me if you can.
I will gather my strength, get up and break their necks... But I need to understand, where is neck on demons' bodies!

What? You have done all my work?
Well! Nice lad! Despite the fact that you are from the League.

My name is Lord Dray as I am responsible for ensuring the Chosen One's orchestra plays consistently note by note. Otherwise, we all fail on the first night. Prove that the Empire is ready to reject hatred and prejudice, and our alliance will be signed.
This device was developed by the leading scientists of the Empire in ZIT. It generates the flow of anti-Astral elementary particles opposed to typical Astral components. Demons are known to weaken outside their native environment, such as hippos without water. Under the radiance of this translocator, demons start losing their power faster. Strange environment forces them out.
This device will help you to fight against demons, but most importantly, gives you a chance to feel respect for your enemy.
So, how convenient is the translocator? After killing demons with it, you will wish you always have it when you bust demons.

So, the device has been tested and I see you are reluctant to return it. That's good. Unfortunately, it is almost useless against the demons of the new breed. They are already more capable of staying in our world, but I'm sure that with time, scientists of Zem will invent something against them.
Do you now understand why it is so important for the League to act in cooperation with the Empire? Combining the achievements of your church and the fruits of scientific thought from the ZIT, you will become the strongest alliance in history. Think about it. Is it not tempting?
Meet Zayan de Desirae, leader of Historians on Avilon, and give him Lord Zullo's Amulet.

It's time to say good-bye. We will surely meet again at the Performance, but now you have to go. I ask you to inform Zayan de Desirae everything you have found out about us. It is unlikely you will ever find a wiser being able to understand everything that has taken place here.
I'm sure that he will resist everything as you first did, but when the time comes, he will be ready to accept the truth.
Here, take my precious amulet which will make it easier for him to believe. It's the same amulet that helped you summon demons near the Astral break. Give it to Zayan. I'm sure he'll know what to do with it.
We asked you to be patient before, now it's time for us to have patience. We will wait until you are ready. When that time comes, demons will cry for their incoming destruction. Let faith in this day connect us wherever you go.
Take care, Chosen One. Remember the lessons of the Path.

Hm...
Taking into account the Lords can manipulate golems and June portals as well as demons who sensed you as "cursed" plus possessing Zullo's amulet, we can only come to one conclusion: You have had the honor to meet the last of the Junes!
They insisted you were led to this conclusion, but I can't believe it. We can use June heritage too although we are not strong enough to repeat their achievements.
At least we now have this amulet... I think I know what to do with it.
Find the way to Gipatia and speak to the elder, Sergey Rybakov.

Welcome to our remote and peaceful allod.
Only here you can find exotic species of thick-skinned boars and putrid spitting toads. For many centuries, their solitary kind accompany our placid life on Gipat. At the foot of the mountains lies a cultured village. Its Elder, Sergey Rybakov, amiably welcomes all who walk the Chosen Path.
What is the Chosen Path? It is the path you create with every step you take. Your actions determine your destiny. In the end, you will earn Revelation!
My colleagues and I will help guide you. Be mindful of what we say and pay attention!
Now take the first step down the road laid before you by the Great Ath-Zak. It was he who found Gipat and cleared the way for people to forge their destiny.
If you ever want to return home, look for the Ruined June Portal's beaming light. Also be sure to hold onto that mysterious stone you've got there. It is your one way ticket back to Gipat.
Perhaps you will encounter other travelers who have lost their way. Push them in the right direction but remember that forging your path is top priority. Now is your time to shine!

People! Today is a great day for our village! We all remember the legend of the Chosen One that is to rise from the Kansha Ruins, and look, you are now among us!
Make haste now! Bring our finest food, best accommodation, and sincere respect. That's what we have to offer for the Chosen One! It is written that you are our rescuer and defender. Look at that brave face. You laugh in the face of danger!
Am I right? You'll manage, won't you?
Die, come back from Purgatory, and tell your death experience to Sarbaz Sobekneferu.

Have you ever experienced fear of death?
Oh, I'm so scared. Do you notice all the wandering souls? Look around you. We kill wild boars and they come back to life! However, they don't resurrect back to their normal form, but in some ghostly state! This got me thinking how revival works here.
I don't want to be a ghost! In fact, I miss my old human body. Those were the good old days. Ladies used to be all over my masculine physique. Unfortunately, all good things come to an end... Look what's become of me? Clothed with metal scraps although it's these sharp shards that keep me breathing. If I am forced to drift in the wind as a cloudy spirit... Forget about it!
I wish there was something or someone that could test my curiosity. Hey! How about you take a one way trip to the Purgatory and show me if you come back in one piece?

Have you seen the light yet?
I asked two individuals before to be my test subjects on this resurrection ordeal. Nobody returned back to their old self. They all became ghosts! Cross my heart and hope not to transform!

What?! You're still... You. Not even a scar!
All right, I believe you. You've given me strength to get out there and exercise these metal joints. Maybe I'll go slash some boars or something.
Ask Cyrano de Blizare, Gella Stulova, and Orichka the Wily about Ath-Zak and return to Stonehoof the Wanderer.

Hello there!
For once in a long time, I'm glad. I never would have thought that you would come near me especially with people seeing our minotaur kind as stupid and wild creatures. I am more than just brute strength. I learned to read and write in Pridonsk, and have earned the title of Demon Hunter!
I'll live up to the expectations and go the Chosen Path. Unlike Orcs who hunt boars and Kanians to cause commotion among the Ruins, I'll never leave the Chosen Path! But I know nothing about this Ath-Zak fellow. Nobody has heard anything about him back in Pridonsk. What about you?
I think there are those who would know like those travelers over there. I doubt that they'll tell me. Everyone thinks I am clever enough with my determination for Revelation. I can see you have a kind heart. If you find out something, will you share it with me?

Did you manage to find out about Ath-Zak?
I constantly hear this name of who he is and what he has done. They say he collected himself among the ruins of the temple, and that the bulk of this area is his doing?
Ah, there you are... It is always difficult to be one with the crowd as a minotaur. Thank you for help. I will continue on my Path and speak well of you.
Scare away 5 Orcish Miscreants around the Kansha Ruins with the Scream-In-The-Box and return to Kalis.

Hello! I've come to Gipat to uphold this ruins' history with my mighty brush and my prideful touch. I need to remake the existing patterns . I thought ancient ruins were free of civilian touch. What a naive aviak I am!
Bolting around earlier on my rounds, I freak out to see the ruins scarred with inscriptions: "Nezeb lived, Nezeb lives, and Nezeb will live on!" And don't get me started on what other unforgivable marks were scratched on the walls! We must do something! We can't let the history of these ruins be soiled with hooligans' lack of respect! Will you help me?
Confront the vandals and scare them away. Take this scream-in-the-box to assist you. Make sure you point it away when you wind it up...

I hope those buggers leave our ruins alone after you deal with them. Why can't they go tag rocks in the mountains where they belong?
Bunch of troublemakers!

I heard the vandals' fearful screams of agony in the distance hehe. Thank you!
Here is a little something for protecting my precious stones.
Offer birch sandals to the ghosts of Gipat upon for Kulo the Dealer.

Welcome, outlander! With new allods comes new clients. And new clients means profit! I have lugged traditional shoes all the way from Lightwood. Lot of shoes! I will make a pretty gold piece.
There's one problem though. I badly need an assistant. Don't worry, I'll share my profit with you if you find clients for my shoes. What we need are new clients. Try your sales charm among those weird ghostly figures at the foot of the stairs...
I had limited space to bring these wares. It was between buckwheat honey or sandals to Gipat. Adventurers need to travel in comfort!

Boy, what a bunch of speechless fools! What are we going to do now?
Stupid me! I should've brought the honey. No one minds healthy eating. That includes ghosts!
 We didn't make big profit although you seem to appreciate good comfort. Try these on for size!

We are told that Gipat is the Path to Revelation. For me it is the way to get filthy rich!
Yeah, yeah! I don't care about this Revelation. Even if we learn something new, what's the point? Is it guaranteed to make our life easy and more complete? I don't think so. I see this Gipat place as a hunters' training ground. There is something materialistic to obtain.
Those curious magical Elves desire ghostly crab shells to create semi-transparent plate armor! Ha! Good luck with that. I never understand their winged-kind.
There are also the sought-after ghost boar fangs! Sharp, slender, and deadly... Perfect for forging a swift blade.
Come, join me in my path of bounty! Bring me shells and fangs. Make sure you bring them back in one piece!
Everyone has his own Revelation. For me it's hard cash!

Thanks!
You know you've got quite the trader in you. Perhaps you should consider that for your Chosen Path.

Bah! I'm so puzzled. I've heard the legend about Ath-Zak many times - waking from his memory loss and finding himself among small ruins. The ruins seem to be remnants of a wall and few columns from back then. But what do we see now? One huge structure! How?
It's known and obvious that ruins crumble over time and not grow...
Are you interested in this mystery? Let's investigate. Search the ruins from top to bottom. Bring me back any unusual stones you find.

Magnificent!
These beautiful ruins really take your breath away when you get higher. The more we connect with these ancient stones, the more we will understand its history.

I see, I see. The stones do not differ!
Yet, both type of stones are affected by different elements over centuries. One stone buried in the ground and worn with water, and the other stone pounded by the holy winds.
Only the all-knowing Great Mage Zayan's magic of Avilon can date these stones back to their origin. Thank you again. This is quite fascinating!
Sprinkle 4 columns in each corner of the Ruins with Divine Water for Anatoly Borschevsky.

Demon tricks! It's all demon tricks I tell you! Listen, everyone! Calling all citizens with ears and more importantly, pure hearts!
What is the Chosen Path? Where does it lead to? Why are there so meany ghostly creatures? What has become of Gipat? It is a dark, rotting place with no holy church or inn for people to commune as one. There's nothing but musty fog and wailing wandering ghosts.
See the salvation! It is time to follow the path of salvation and rid of the evil that makes us blind! Take this holy water! Sprinkle it on the demonic ruins! May the healing light lead us out of darkness and into the light!

Holy water will do the trick! Let's do it at last!
Let the Light shine upon these haunted ruins! Let the darkness fade away into nothingness!

I am grateful for your help!
It's rumored there's an ancient village nearby. Go there quickly before night falls.
What devil brought me to the very end of this world to the land of apparitions? And that Ath-Zak... How am I to look up to someone with a name that doesn't sound Kanian at all?!

Have a look! What a view - crumbled walls, pillars of tragedy! What do you think happened here centuries ago?
Suppose it was a temple and inside were corrupt priests ripping the hearts right out of Gibberlings' chests! Maybe this was a palace where a caged young Elf waited for her prince charming mounted on a mystical dragon to free her, and soar into the moonlit night. Or rather she was traded to a foul ogre to fulfill his nasty intentions.
Ah, what an inspiration! I've just pictured the final scene. Trembling Elf at the edge of the allod, her hair uncurling and the majestic palace behind...
But... these ugly animals... boars, their smothering aura ruins my fantasy!
Would you kindly remove them from my sight so I can continue daydreaming?

Oh, those ghostly beasts!
My hands tremble as I feel their heavy presence surrounding us.

So there are no more boars by the Ruins?
Now I can come closer to picture that illusion from another angle. I am so grateful to you and your appreciation of art!
Now, please don't obstruct the view.
Treat everyone with a glass of mead upon the Tipsy Family's request.

Weird place, isn't it? What are you looking for here? Revelation? Pfff, big deal!
Who knows, maybe this Ath-Zak character never existed at all. Have you seen him? We sure haven't! Back at the Frozen Frontier inns, there are juicier rumors more worthy of our time! I bet you two to one that all this nonsense is to attract tourists. And maybe even worse... Hic.
Well, assuming this Ath-Zak guy is floating around, beer is on us. We've brought the best mead in all of Sarnaut. It's our treat. Come now, let's raise our glasses. The path... leads to... the Chosen Path!

Well, how do you like our mead? Warm and bubbly, eh?
We really want to know what the Orcs think. We want to see how it'll affect their awareness...

Well, no more beer left, it's time to go.
No, wait. Off we go! That sounds better... Hic.

...For me? Ha! ...From the Gibberlings? Ha!
The world has certainly changed if Gibberlings are offering me ale. Well, I suppose it's worth the risk.
Pass it to me.
h: Give them a glass of porter

t: Give a speech in the Ruins on behalf of Oxana Fedorova.

Oh, the distress! My heart bleeds of utter sorrow for all these League citizens. If conflict amongst the races continue, I can't imagine what will destroy the country first: the nobles' selfish actions or population will be swept away by alcoholism and syphilis.
How is it possible to drink today while ignoring order and morals?
Hey you, country bumpkins! I am just trying to tell the truth!
Hm, people don't seem to be listening to me. Help me! Raise yourself to get the crowds' attention and tell everybody the truth of our unrest!
In an era of menace, it's unbelievable to sleep by the fire and be afraid of being beaten by birch rods in a bathhouse where there isn't a single hint of cleanliness!
Are you don't spreading the influence? Thank you! A great task has been accomplished!

Aha, you think you're so tough from picking on less-skilled warriors from the Holy Land?!
Try your strength against me! Let's see who's better at cracking crabs! I'm the greatest warrior and hunter! Who do you think you are?

Well, didn't that feel good? The Truce isn't going to stop those who were born to fight!
Best of luck on your Path!
Find the murderer of Eric de Vevre.

Hey you! Have a look here. Maybe my eyes deceive me, but I stumbled upon this fallen Elf!
I think he's dead! Can you see marks of boar fangs or wolf claws? Me neither!
What could of caused this unnatural death? Did the dragon spirits lie to us? What happened to the Truce we were assured upon arriving at Gipat?
How are we expected to stroll these trails without turning our head every minute? There's only unspeakable way of dealing with this. Find the renegade killer and punish him! For the sake of peace!

Here's another dead body! Orc stripped of his decency!
Let's take a closer look.
Summon and defeat the Phantom Goblin as Ath-Zak once did outside the entrance of Gipatia, and report to the Spirit of Courage.

This is the last test before the gates of Gipatia. This is where Ath-Zak found goblins roaming around the pasture. They stood like a wall in their overwhelming masses. He lifted his bronze knife and inflicted a crushing blow to the back of a goblin's head. The goblin fell and his companions quaked with fear!
Many of you are here to fulfill the Chosen Path. That's why goblins are here too. But don't get too cocky. They won't hold back like how they did with Ath-Zak. These goblins have grown to be more fierce over time.
This is the last easy step compared to what you will have to face down the road. It's all uphill from here. Every move will take energy and every turn will drain your life force.

Gipatia is the center of fate. Here is the center ground for all roads and all threads are interwoven here.
Now you are standing in the front the door of your legacy.

The road leading to Gipatia is open to you now.
Calm your emotions, take a breath, and enter...
Ask Spirit of Resolve about the Chosen Path.

You've proven yourself to my colleagues and you have earned your way into our village.
The Chosen Path leads through Gipatia. This is where Ath-Zak had unique interactions with many people. They faithfully served him, traded him, and even deceived him.
By following Ath-Zak's path, you are the Chosen One now! Go through all his perils: suffer his pain, smile from his joy, feel his disappointment, and burn with his love.
Do you want to know more? Talk to me and I'll tell you all you need to know in order to move forward.

Perfect. Everything is falling into place as foreseen.
I'm taking away the artifact you used to get here, as you are now allowed to use the portal of Gipat.
If you have questions, you know where you can find me.
Confront Yaver Useranat who killed Erl's Family.

Yeah, we attacked that Xadaganian loser, but the Brave Family are definitely not murders. It was him who beat down our friend Maxim Kulakin, so we retaliated.
And to think, we had just started our Chosen Path. Now I am all alone...
Great ghost!
There he is, there he is! Murderer of my brothers! Damned Yaver Useranat.
How can I get my revenge now? When Elm always protected the three of us with his shield, and Edge aimed the bow while I pulled the arrow?
To hell with the Truce! I'll choke the damn bastard!

Look who's sulking! Your face is flushed with rage. What's wrong?
Well, yes, it was me who sprayed the Brave ones with acid. You got a problem with that? It was fair play.
I had to avenge my friend.
Find Eric de Vevre around Gipatia and make sure he is alive.

Hear me out before you point fingers. The three of us were on our way to Gipatia with my assistant falling behind. That impatient Seaside went off the trail to fetch my assistant.
Then I heard shouting, steel clattering ahead of us. When we got to the scene, Seaside was already dead. Semyon was standing above him with blood-soaked hands. Where's the truce in that?! Well, we showed him. Maxim and I beat and fried his body to a crisp. He deserved it though. Kanian scum!
Wait, that's not the end of it. Before we could get far, that family of pipsqueaks poured out from the bushes and fired a volley of arrows! What did you think I was going to do? Just stand there and eat steel?
What? Eric de Vevre dead? Yeah, Seaside beat him even before this confusion started. That silly Elf picked the wrong Orc to gawk at. Relax, Eric resurrected awhile ago.
The rest of the Brave Family will also return from Purgatory soon, or did they not have any drops of myrrh left? Well, let that Erl weep for now. Don't you believe me? Eric seems to be around the village already. Find him and see for yourself.

Listen, do you have any extra drops of mirra? I'm short of it. Yeah, yeah, that was my corpse back near the ruins. I just returned from Purgatory as you can see.
What? No, no grudge against anyone. I shouldn't of picked a quarrel with that Orc. I'm still getting used to Gipat and the truce between both factions.
Find the illegal arena in the forest.

Don't you understand we can't live in peace? Most of us are frisky , eager individuals who invest gold on weapons and armor. How do you propose we release our ongoing stress? Shall we hunt boars all day? No, rational beings need to blow off steam in a good wrestling match. Maybe that's why I picked a fight with that oversized Orc.
Do you belong to those Truce cultists? I'll let you in on a little secret... We organized a kind of underground arena southwards from this village. It's deep in the forest covered up nicely by towering trees. But don't tell anybody especially those dragon spirits.
Don't get me wrong, we're all fighting towards the Chosen Path though we can't do without our guilty pleasure every now and then.

Oh! A new face! More fun for me! The more, the better!
That flying mongrel, I mean, that baby dragon didn't tag along with you, did it? I don't want to blow the good thing we have going on here.
Set up 4 Shaman Scarecrows on the edges of the arena for Seaside the Bloodthirsty.

Everybody brandishes fists after a good fight, win or lose! Why not join our secret club?
I have shaman scarecrows. I'd better plant them around the arena to scare away those winged spirits in case they show up. The scarecrows are so freaky! It'll make those dragon party-poopers flee in terror! Hopefully...
Well, if not, the puppets will distract them, and we will have time to run like hell!
Nah, they won't catch us. If they do, they will probably take our Signs of the Chosen, and I'll lose all my arena smash brothers! Since you are here, set up the scarecrows around the arena for me.
You don't have a choice. Resist and I'll give you a black eye!

I've had only one fight since I got to Gipat and I lost it. What a fail Orc I am. Shame on me!
I'm in poor shape. More training! As soon as we make the arena ready for all, I'm going to beat your asses up.

Now even a bootlicker has no chance of discovering our arena! We are safe. Great battles will take place and many will travel to Gipat to witness our underground playground.
If we're expected to exist without being able to bash things with our fists, then to hell with the Chosen Path! I hate the hype with Ath-Zak! He died three hundred years ago. It's not worth making a fuss about it!

You did such a great job with those ogres. Would you mind lending me another hand? Don't worry about goldy over there, we'll be discreet...
Have you seen the local wolves and toads? Disgusting creatures, eh? Although they are not useless.
One of my fellow shamans needs ghost toad eggs and wolf fangs. I didn't catch what for... Something about the Kingdom of Nature and new pagan potions. I have nothing to do with their crazy voodoo ways, but he said that he would pay well for collecting the necessary materials.
So, are you in? We'll share the profit. You know I'm good for my word!
I should have demanded more from that shaman. When I told him I can get his ghostly junk, his eyes were sparkling like hell.

Yeah! Nice hunting!
There. It's your share of the gold. And something for the long road ahead.
Follow the instructions of Spirit of the Rage, kill the wolf with the ritual bronze knife.

You are in the early stage of your Path. Much is in store for you and you will experience difficult tasks and dangerous challenges. The Path is not for the weak-spirited. Don't travel from the Path; believe in yourself; and you will finally attain great knowledge... Revelation!
Three hundred years ago the brilliant Chosen One, Ath-Zak, woke with nothing but a bronze knife in his hand. Follow us, repeat his actions. Ath-Zak didn't know who he was and what was in store for him. I assure you, great mystery is waiting to be unveiled by you, and you will be terrified by what you learn. However, he who follows the Path of the Chosen One will gain great power.
Onto the first step. A wolf blocked Ath-Zak directly in the middle of his Path. It was the first creature which he used his knife against, which stain his knife with blood. You are to survive this battle too, and Sign of Chosen will be the reward.

Ath-Zak stumbled from the ruins from his slumber only to find a fierce wolf blocking his path.
Only the one who kills the wolf can carry on with his Path.

Yeah, Ath-Zak killed the wolf with two accurate strikes. Every new accomplishment on your Chosen Path will reward you with a Sign of the Chosen. This special medallion is made of bronze, the only element that Ath-Zak possessed on Gipat.
The more Signs you acquire, the closer you will be to your Revelation. Move onward, Chosen One!
Find the murderers of Eric de Vevre and Seaside the Bloodthirsty.

Poor Orc... Something stabbed him right through the chest, just like stabbing fish in a barrel.
His fractured skull and gashes seem to be caused from hammers and sword blows. Whoever did this certainly had help. I must find these violators of the Truce before more beings become victims of their twisted ways.
Ugh. Another corpse. Let me turn it over. Ouch! Magic! This poor Kanian had his eyeballs disintegrated from lightning charges. This doesn't make any sense. Who would do such a thing?

Who do these Anthropologists think they are trying to attract truth-seeking individuals with promises of some Revelation? I'm a scientist. I need facts, data, and proof before I take one step into some forsaken Path. I agreed to find an explanation how these ghostly creatures walk among the living without hindering the balance of nature.
Hear out my hypothesis. Disaster struck this allod and the Astral consumed everything! That could explain why sparks of the dead act as if these creatures were alive in their original state? It means that the poor things missed their death...
I have brought back Astral sparks from ZIT to test my hypothesis. If you want to help the investigation, please collect some sparks of these strange creatures. Let's try boars and toads!

Maybe there is some strange Purgatory freak out and their souls get lost between the worlds.
And I thought being an Arisen and rising from the dead that I would have seen everything in this lifetime...
What? No soul at all? Not a single one? What kind of heartless creatures are these?! Looks like I must continue my research. Please leave me. I cannot think with you blocking my thoughts.
Find the killers of Eric de Vevre, Seaside the Bloodthirsty, and Semyon Gromov.

I must put an end to this investigation once and for all! The multiple causes of death can only mean it was the doing of multiple killers. It was probably a gang of heartless scum. It won't be long until I smoke them out of the rock that they're hiding under!
Ugh, what do you want? Yes, I was wounded... by Gibberlings... the Brave Family to be precise... Three against one... what bastards...
Slither past Ogres like a cunning snake and meet Spirit of Bravery.

Hail to the Chosen One on his way to Revelation! Remember fighting is not always the solution. If we cannot dominate foes by force then outsmarting them is the preferred option. Cross this bridge and you will come across three horrible ogres. They beat their clubs in unison to make one's blood run cold.
Ath-Zak still recovering from the struggle with the wolf had no strength to fight the savages. He lay on his belly and carefully glided like a snake past the ogres.
Show me your expertise and outdo the giants as Ath-Zak once did. You'll eventually meet my fellow comrade along the road. Show him how stealthy you can be!

Replicating Ath-Zak's actions is an important part of your Path. You have displayed great dexterity. Soon we will discover if you have enough courage to move forward. It won't be long until we see if you're worthy to enter Gipatia.
Meet Spirit of Acceptance on the way to Gipatia.

Your next step on the way to Revelation is meeting Spirit of Acceptance. The Chosen One was smart enough not to waste effort. Nobody could notice him move, not even the sharpest eye. You will have to learn this, too.
You truly are the Chosen one!
Find the alleged murderers, the Family of the Brave ones.
It was them... the Brave Family! The shooting, the hacking... It was horrible! I almost didn't make it out alive. Find them and teach them a lesson about the Truce. Please!

No, why, oh why?! They are dead, my brothers are dead! We should have trusted our guts and not have opened the letter revealing the black stone that led us here.
What shall I do now? I'm all alone... Hey! Don't you trouble me! Who the heck are you? What do you want?
Lure the Phantom Ogre to Roughneck clan hunters and take it down together.

What insolence!
You'll never catch me alive hiding from these ogres like some pitiful Gibberling! I am from the Roughneck Clan! I look death straight in the face and cleave everything in my way!
I have a plan. I call it "We'll cut our own path!" Ha!
Let's forget about this Chosen Path and just kill everything in Gipat! Every single living being! My clan all agree with me! This is the way for real hunters! Genocide will be our Revelation!
Lure one ogre to my brothers and dominate it together! Don't hold back! It's time for a slaughterfest!
Our Roughneck Orc kind dare not "slither" past any challenge. We stop at nothing... Kill everything. Genocide on Gipat!
Good work! You're not as bad a hunter as I thought you would be! There's still two ogres but leave them to me. I'm hungry for more!
Think about what's troubling Spirit of Bravery.

What are you doing, imbecile?!
Why are you deviating from the Path by helping that hate-driven Orc kill ogres? Such actions are not the same Path as the first Chosen One.
If you do not listen to our advice, we cannot help you achieve Revelation. Can you imagine what will wait for you in the end if you sink yourself down that low?

The Chosen Path conceals many dangerous situations, but even more trouble await those who turn from it. Once you start to drift from the Path, you may not be able to find your way back. Always remember that.
Ath-Zak will be far ahead so that catching up to his accomplishments will be impossible. You won't receive anymore Signs of the Chosen, Revelation will be discovered by others, and you will vanish in darkness all alone without knowing anything. Take a look into the river at your cloudy reflection. Is that your real fate?
I won't punish you... This time.
But listen to me carefully and heed my warning. Be wise and do not turn from the Path!

Woe is me!
You won't believe what happened! Look, there's a hole in the bag! I've lost half of my stuff, but that's not the worst part. Oh, no, no... I've lost my Signs of the Chosen!
What shall I do? I asked help from the dragon guides, but they said I'm too clumsy to be a Chosen One. My Path is blocked off now!
No way! Flying liar! I refuse to believe this is the end after all the troubles I have been through to get here! I'm asking, no, I'm begging you. Please help me? I've been all around this village. I've looked into boxes, chests, and barrels.
I went in search for some food to ease my hunger pains, but found only roaches. Maybe I should retrace my footsteps back over there in case my growling tummy distracted me from my search. If you come across my Signs, give them back to me!

I cannot progress with my Path without the Signs!
Who knows, maybe pigs have trampled my Signs deep in the mud.

Oh, many thanks to you! I'll never forget what you've done for me!
Yes, they are all here! My precious...
I am the Chosen One again!
Buy a Chunk of Flint from Boris, record Sergey and Gorislav's conversation, and kick a Ghostly Pig for Delmon de Blizare.

Another Chosen One! Isn't it strange that so many individuals have come to Gipat to complete their Path?
I have been collecting the legends about Ath-Zak my whole life and I dared not to think that I would once see the myths coming alive. It's hilarious! Now I wonder how things work in Gipat.
Will you help me? I want to check if the legends come true literally. I'd like you to do three things.
First, buy a flint from Boris Polonsky.
Then you should sneak up at Sergey and Gorislav while they chat and activate this recording device.
And, finally, kick a village pig. Sounds random, huh? But that's exactly what Ath-Zak did when he arrived at Gipatia. I'm sure he did not do such a harsh act out of malice, because he was a good man.
So, will you help me?

The village seems to be quite different from what I'd thought it would be!
Ah, what a luck it is to turn the time back and visit the place that others have only read about. All fantasies fade back to reality but this one! Who knows how precise the stories of Ath-Zak might be? We are going to find that out now!

Well, let's see what we have here.
Flint is like any ordinary flint. The speech differs a bit from that in the biographies of Ath-Zak, but that is not surprising. And the pig is a typical ghostly creature like we have on Gipat.
I will send all this evidence to Zayan back in Avilon for his research. We have other business to attend to now.

Reach out to three League citizens: Romeo de Ardeur, Cheerful Family, and Polina Zaitseva. Romeo de Ardeur requires 5 Wildflowers, Cheerful Family needs a pair of birch sandals, and Polina Zaitseva wants a Mana Lantern. Learn everything they know about the League's plans and report to Viktor Tverdolobin.

Stop! Secret order for all Imperials. I'd like you to meet Nina Krasavina, an athlete and committee worker, and a very beautiful woman. We expect her to attain Revelation first and bring pride to the Empire.
Every single one of us should work toward Nina's success. We plan to have each Imperial member on their Path who have earned Signs of the Chosen to give them to Nina. The Empire should be the first to receive Revelation!
That's not all! We need to know what the League is planning and if they have a plan to get the Revelation before us. Not far from here there is a small League camp. We should gain their trust and learn everything. This important task is yours. If you are successful, we won't pressure you into giving your Signs to Nina.
There is an elf who fell in love, he's looking for Wildflowers for his beloved one. They are growing along the road to the Village - bring him at least five, and he will tell you everything.
Gibberlings need a new footwear - present them a pair of birch sandals, and they will be both grateful and talkative.
Polina Zaitseva is afraid of the dark... Why don't you get her a Mana Lantern to set her mind at rest? I heard Nezebrad smugglers sell one.
Is everything clear? Bring back good news.

What's the status report?
If you cannot find out what the League is up to, give me all your Signs, and I will give this order to someone more worthy!

Wonderful report!
Let's go over their plans: the League intends to host a contest among its citizens. Whoever is the first to achieve Revelation gets awarded a luxurious mansion in the heart of Novograd.
At least our plan with Nina is better - all for one! But it's better to mess around with the League during the process just for fun.

Reach out to three Imperial Citizens: Razh the Fearless, Sarbaz Neferkahor, and Arina Shakirova. Razh the Fearless requires a Stone Hammer, Sarbaz Neferkahor wants an exotic beer, and Arina Shakirova requires a Kanian Shawl. Learn everything they know about the Empire's plans and report to Laure de Grandeur.

Bless the light! Listen, it is very important for the League and its citizens to achieve Revelation first. Who knows what it entails!
Government promises to reward those who will be first. Luxurious mansion in the heart of Novograd is only a slice of the cake! So don't waste time. Forward to the Chosen Path!
I wish I could find out how much the Empire has accomplished so far. Something troubles me. Not far from here, Imperial citizens have settled. It's all so weird... Only yesterday we killed each other in the Holy Lands and today we walk by them and only raise eyebrows instead of swords. But they won't open their hearts to a Priest of the Church like me.
You seem neutral to this Truce. Perhaps you can find out the Empire's plans. Try to connect with them.
Razh the Fearless is always happy to try on a new weapon. Bring him a stone hammer in exchange for the information. I know a local trader sells one.
Sarbaz Neferkahor has run out of exotic beer. If you lend him a hand he will surely loosen his tongue.
When I last saw Arina Shakirova, she was shivering with cold. A nice Kanian shawl would make her warm and grateful. I remember a Novograd trader offered me one.
May the Light guide you!
The people I'm having you seek out are part of some committee. It's obvious that Empire has evil plans. Save us from darkness!

Everything is clear.
Imperials are collecting Signs and giving them all to Nina Krasavina. If this persists, she will obtain Revelation faster than anyone from the League. Very valuable information. We must put a stop to their cheating ways!
Kill the Goblin Trapper blocking way to the Windswept Foothills for Sergey Rybakov.

Listen to me, Chosen One. Our village has been swarmed by goblins countless times. Surprisingly for goblins, those creatures think one step ahead and set up a post somewhere along the east path with a watchman in case we tried to seek help from outside of Gipatia.
When our warriors try to leave the village, their designated guard immediately hears the clanking of our clumsy armor, and calls for help. But you, Chosen One, are here to rid of us such troubles. I have faith you can overcome the goblin watchman, so our villagers can roam around without being harassed by something half our size!
Don't underestimate the guard's short stature though. Those goblins always have tricks up their sleeves...

We will wait and hope!
But we're not going to worry about you as the Chosen One cannot fail as long as he keeps his friends close...

I am grateful to you, oh, Chosen One! And all citizens of our village too! Now we can graze our cattle on pastures and not fear the goblins keeping us locked in like caged toads. Let's hope for the best!
Talk about the captured souls to Evgenya Radova.

My mission to seek the truth has come to a halt. It is beyond my scope, it surpasses all my knowledge...
To tell the truth, I'm afraid that my faith is shaken. I think it's time to go to the servant of the Light. Seek guidance from Evgenya Radova.

What happened? Why the troubled face?
No, it is absolutely impossible! Magic of the Light is not intended to enslave sparks and imprison them! You've made a grave mistake. That Delmon is just a historian and you are a simple adventurer. One shouldn't meddle in affairs above your comprehension.
Die and bribe Goblin Spirit in Purgatory with a Vial of Mirra.

Let's presume that you are right and Holy magic is used here... I know how we should proceed. In the world of the dead, we must speak their language. You have to die.
Don't be afraid. As usual, you will find yourself in Purgatory, but do not be hasty to return. Talk to the acolyte. He can do more than resurrect fallen soldiers so that they can fight once again with the same amount of vigor. He can also let a soul out to the world.
I invite you to return to the village in the same bodiless form like other ghosts of Gipat. Then you can communicate with them on equal terms.
Of course, it is not easy to persuade the acolyte to alter the usual ritual. But we all know that he likes mirra. I'll give you a whole vial and he won't be able to resist!

Hey, again without waiting in line?
What an impudence! It is not enough that world is a mess, and you are just dying to return back to your wretched life!

Aha, now we're talking! You should of told me right away.
Hm, lovely mirra... So you want me to bring you back to the world as a ghost?
Yeah, I can do it. Hold onto your head!
Talk to Gipat ghosts: Sergey Rybakov, Gorislav Averchenko, Boris Polonsky and Osip Bazhov. After the conversations, return to real world and report to Evgenya Radova.

Oh, I hope the locals won't think I'm a fool...
Listen to me, ghost back from Purgatory! I can't see you, but I know you're here and can hear me.
While in your apparition form, talk to other Gipat ghost citizens and find out everything that is going on around here!
Again!
Listen to me, ghost from Purgatory!
I have never felt so stupid! Everybody is staring at me speaking into thin air!

Wow! Thank the Light!
My efforts are not in vain. What have you found out?
Really? Poor ghosts have to perform this weird Performance every single day without knowing the reason. They don't even remember what happened to them and what brought them to their ghostly state.
We must help them!
Following request of Victor Terdolobin, take three Signs of the Chosen from three League citizens: Romeo de Ardeur, Cheerful Family, and Polina Zaitseva.

Now we know that everybody is madly searching for Signs of the Chosen on the League. Let's take advantage of this. The most suitable tactic is to find weak point in the enemy and hit that spot dead on!
Elf in love? Here is the shard of a bracelet that goblins used to wear. This is a very nice piece of aboriginal art. I'm sure Romeo would like to present it to his sweetheart. Show Gibberlings ghostly leather. These fluffy creatures have never seen armors made of such material that will protect them from the dangers of Gipat. And the woman who is afraid of darkness - we can present her with an Amulet of the Fearless.
But we need Signs of the Chosen from each and every one of them.

Individualism can never defeat team spirit. All together, shoulder to shoulder, and Nina will get the revelation first!
Moreover, it's even better to deprive the League from their hard-earned Signs.

Well done! Here is a Sign of the Chosen just for you.
I probably should give it to Nina, but one less Sign won't hurt. The Empire is still ahead anyway. And your efforts deserves a reward.
Following the request of Laure de Grandeur, take three Chosen Signs from three Imperial citizens: Razh the Merciless, Sarbaz Neferkahor, and Arina Shakirova.

If the Imperial citizens are forced to give away their Signs, it means that they aren't of great value to them. That's the mistake of the Committee. Imperials have underestimated the significance of what the Signs of the Chosen stand for, and that will bring troubles.
I'm not going to let those cheaters walk away with my mansion! We should get a little dirty and cheat those Signs from the Imperial citizens.
That Orc likes shiny things... I'm sure he'll enjoy playing with this medallion. I also have an exclusive potion recipe for the alchemist. It was prepared by Forestfolk of Gipat. How it works - nobody knows. And I suppose that Xadaganian is trembling not with cold, but with fear. Offer her a magic guard.
Return when you have all three of their Signs.

Have you managed to get the Imperials' Signs?
Remember, it is not impossible to find a way if one does not try!

You see, the Empire view Signs of the Chosen as cheap copper just like I said.
They've lost their Signs and turned from the Path so easily! Lots of things bother minds of simple fools. Such individuals do not deserve Ath-Zak's fate and Revelation. I'm laughing at such Chosen ones.
Here, take this Sign and move forward with your Chosen Path!
Take a Carved Bracelet from Rord the Ghostly and bring it to Romeo de Ardeur.

I am sure it's possible to acquire a complete bracelet from one of goblins. I heard about some crafty ghost goblin... He is probably their leader. Maybe he has a whole bracelet!
Oh, is she accepts the charm from me, puts it on, and let its cold metal press against her skin... Oh, my heart beats faster from the thought of it. She will then be under my loving influence. But what if something happens to me? I cannot die on the very threshold of happiness.
Find the goblin bracelet for me and I will give you my Sign of the Chosen. Of course, it will lead me one step behind from a luxurious mansion in Novograd, but it will bring me one step closer to her!

She will be a queen among Elves! Many of them are wear jewels crafted from the finest Elven masters.
But this fancy bracelet won't decorate just any hand... Only to my sweetheart!
All other Elves will die from envy.

Oh! Wonderful artistic masterpiece! It feels like something primal yet pure as child's soul.
I'll go and give her this bracelet. Look at me. How do I look? Is my shirt free of wrinkles?
Here is my Sign as promised. Wish me good luck!
Summon Orc duelist on the west field using the Horn and defeat him in the duel. Tell Razh the Merciless the results of the duel.

As much as I love a wild fight... I have six Signs of the Chosen! I don't want to have any issues with the dragons.
But I bet my comrade will accept your challenge for me. He's not as dedicated to the Path like I am although I bet my Sign on your head!
But please, meet him outside the Village. There is a small field to the west with a giant totem pole crushed into the allod. Here is a horn of my clan. Blow it and it will make a combat sound that will echo with the wind. My comrade will come running and beat you.
Ha! Say goodbye to your Sign!
In reality, there is no Truce with all this fighting going on. What nonsense!

Yes, I already heard what happened...
Heh, I should of ran off once I heard you beat my buddy! But a bargain is a bargain. Here is my sign! Take it!
Just one request... Don't tell anybody that my friend fell so easily in combat. Ok?
Bring 8 ghostly skins of ghost boars to Cheerful Family.

But we really, really want to own such armor so badly!
What can we do? We have tried hunting with no success and we ran out of gold. You know what!? We will give you our Sign of the Chosen! Deal? Just bring us some ghostly skins. It'll be enough for first-class armor. And then wolfs and fogs will know fear the next time three shadows cross their path!

Can you imagine, my brothers, we will return to Holy Land in new phantom armor!
And that Prude Family won't slam doors right before our noses anymore! We want, no, we NEED that ghost armor!

We finally have our hands on skin. Wonderful! We will run to the tailor immediately!
Here is our Sign. If you are in the Holy Land, come visit us.
Find White Flower and Evergreen Leaf for Sarbaz Neferkahor.

Yes, yes, I'll keep my word and give you my Sign if you find such plants that will allow me to brew this complex potion: white flower and evergreen leaf.
Of course I could set out on my own and search for the ingredients, but I think I'm more fit for cleaning tubes instead of coming face to face with snorting ghostly boars.
So, do we agree? You bring me flowers, I'll give you my Sign of the Chosen in exchange!

An ancient potion. It seemed that a knowledge about it was lost forever. And now I'm holding it's recipe in my hands. I'm a step away from a great discovery!
Wait a minute. What if all those plants... white flower, evergreen leaf... gone extinct long ago? No! I don't want to think about it!

What do we have here? A white flower. Mmm, such a fragrant scent...
Evergreen leaf... Oh! I have never seen such a vibrant green color in my whole life. I'm so anxious to start brewing. Here is your sign, take it!
Test Amulet of the Fearless on a chicken near the wolves. Tell about success to Polina Zaitseva.

What are you saying? With this amulet, even a hen will be brave as lion? Hm...
You talk big, but show me proof. Around the Village there are lots of ghostly chickens around.
Wrap the amulet around one their little necks and bring it to the forest where wolves prey, and let's see what happens. If the chicken attacks without any fear, it means that you're not lying and this amulet possesses great power!

Wait a minute!
What if I equip this amulet and start to unwillingly attack those who are more powerful than? I won't live long after that. Am I right?
Nevertheless, I have more brains than chickens. So, is this amulet working as you predicted?

Come on, I'll wear it... Hm... a strange feeling.
There was an Orc near here. He gave me dirty looks yesterday. He wrapped his large hands around my neck and pressed me against the wall. Now I'll go and show him that I'm no pushing around type!
What's that? Ah, yes, my Sign. Here it is. Take it.
Test Arina Shakirova's magic guard in combat.

If you wish to earn my Sign, you must make sure this magic guard works.
Does he know exactly who is friend and who is enemy? Will the guard attack its master? What is said about it in the instructions?
Please conduct your experiments away from here. At the gates of the village is an abandoned house. Summon the guard there. If he defeats all your enemies and won't attack you, return to me, and I'll trade you my Sign.
If the magic guard works properly, I can feel safe in wherever I go. Phew...

How did he perform in the field? Perfect?
My sweetie guardian, now you will defend me! What should I call him?
Ah, I almost forgot... Here is your Sign of the Chosen.

Glad to see you! Our numbers are growing!
We have already encountered the living inhabitants of Gipat. They are not so friendly!
Wild goblins are the ugliest and most repulsive! They don't like us being here. They keep trying to prod us with their spears or fling boomerangs at our heads.
We should give them a fight! Show that we are the new masters of Gipat. Well, in a sense we all are. You too, Chosen One.
So are you game? In order to prove your victory, bring us the goblins' spears and boomerangs.
Only wild Orcs are worse than wild goblins. Soon they will be defeated too!

Great!
Thanks for putting them in their place. Now goblins will recognize the Chosen One!
Here is your reward!
Kill the Ghostly White Wolf, Ghostfang, and bring its head to Sergey Rybakov.

Besides goblins, Gipatia is also terrorized by wolves. Perhaps you, Chosen One, can deal with them?
The pack stealing our cattle is led by the fearless Ghostfang. This particular breed is smarter than any four-legged beast we have encountered. It's one big game to the wolf as he has played tricks on our hunters numerous times! Only you, Chosen, can outwit this devil. Your bravery and quick wits will leave that white wolf dead in its tracks!

I know the Chosen one cannot fail! I have great faith!
The White Wolf will be slain and all of Gipatia will celebrate! Glory to the Chosen one!

I admire your bravery and nobility! If beheading the beast at my request makes you a little queasy, give the wolf's head to Gorislav. Your Path is important although your demonstration of savagery for our greater good shows a lot about you, and it's an important lesson for completion of your Path.
Our village governor wants people to believe in him and you have helped our village keep up with faith by ridding of the evil that surrounds us. Now hand over the head; I'll present it to him myself. Take this Sign and keep it close to your heart.
Retrieve Boris' Toolbox from the bandits' Chief and his wife.

Well, look who it is! Here comes the Chosen One. Just because of who your glorious title, don't think for a second that you will get anything for free! Before you earn my respect you've got to take back what was taken from me!
Who robbed me of my belongings? It was those blasted "free hunters" as our elder calls them. He says that they are our friends, but friends don't deprive others from what they own! Those rebels are bandits that have brought shame upon Gipatia, and have been cast off to dwell out of our village.
My apprentice caught them looking through our materials, and tried to stop them, but they beat him and ran off with my tools. My dear friend has been shaken by this experience for the past two days, and has not found the will to work since then!
They have taken many things, but what is worse is they took my favorite drill and hand blade. I need those back or else I'm a useless merchant! Help me!

My tools were made of a rare material! You will never find anything like them in all of Sarnaut.
Now the Chief's stout wife is crafting jewelry with my drill! And the Chief is using my cutter for his no good intentions!

Is that my drill? No, it's not! Hand blade is not mine either!
Look at that! Here comes the Chosen One to save the day but cannot even fulfill a simple request. Expect no such discounts from me, that's for sure. You cannot expect me to bow before your clumsiness when my tools are still out there handled by those bandits!
Just, please give me some space. I need to re-think how I'm going to be able to continue my sales without my proper tools...
Get 12 Ghost Amulets from Spectral Rogues and Spectral Corsairs, and bring them to Yaver Useranat.

Hold up!
Do you want to earn some money? I have an opportunity you simply cannot refuse.
While you may not believe your eyes, you can see there are an abundant of ghosts inhibiting Gipat. Let's just say I have a professional interest in them.
I have heard few rumors about the nature of their existence, but it's all rubbish to me. I act according to my instinct rather than waste my days theorizing.
There have been ghost bandits spotted to the northeast of Gipatia. I am interested in their... Components. Relax! I am not speaking about brains, liver, and such organs. I'm talking about amulets. Not all necromancers are into such morbidity, you know?
Ghost amulets are curious jewels. I'm sure that I can use them for my "professional" goals. The only thing left is to find them.
Won't you help?

Ha! I see you're anxious to know what I need these amulets for.
I cannot tell you for now but maybe I'll tell you if you bring me the amulets.

Perfect.
You've acquired the amulets I needed so it's only fair to give an explanation for my desire.
These ghost amulets have mysterious powers of Gipat's ghosts. I'm going to use this power for my dark ways. I don't care about it's properties. Divine, Elemental, Astral... Power itself is more important than the source of it.
Remember that if you want to make it out of Gipat alive.
